initial_prompt: I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed with work today. Just too many things piling up.

messages.content: I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed with work today. Just too many things piling up.

I'm sorry to hear that. That feeling of the pile getting higher while you're trying to dig your way out is completely exhausting. It’s hard to focus when it feels like everything is screaming for your attention all at once.

Is there a specific deadline looming over you, or is it just the sheer volume of everything hitting you at the same time? I'm here if you want to vent about it or if you just need a distraction for a few minutes.
